Why custom, why now

One-size-fits-all software fits nobody.

The big platforms have to do the basics for everyone, so they never quite fit anyone. You end up paying per seat for features you don't use, and working around the one you need.

Now a custom system takes days, not months. So why bend your business to fit someone else's software?

Pricing

Jobs, not subscriptions.

Every job gets a fixed quote before we start. Here's roughly how they shake out.

Small job

from $100

A quick fix or one automation. Think an auto-reminder email or a report template.

Medium job

from $500

A tool or workflow. Think a quoting tool or a monthly report that builds itself.

Big job

Ask about care

Questions

Good question.

And if yours isn't here, we're happy to have a chat.

Do you use AI to build?

Yes. It helps us build faster, which keeps prices down. Real people plan it, check it and look after it.

Do I need to know what software I need?

Not at all. Tell us what you're trying to do, or what's slowing you down. We'll work out a practical next step and explain it in plain English.

How much will it cost?

It depends on the job. We'll give you a fixed-price quote for the agreed work before we start. Any hosting or ongoing costs are set out too, so you can make a proper decision.

Can you work with the tools I already use?

Usually, yes. Gmail, Outlook, Xero, MYOB, spreadsheets and plenty more. We'll check what's possible before recommending anything new.

Can you help with a small job?

Absolutely. One repetitive job taken off your hands is a perfectly good place to start.

What happens once it's built?

We walk you through it and make sure you know how to use it. If you'd like ongoing help, the optional $50/month Sunday Care Plan covers maintenance and agreed small changes.

Why Sunday?

Because there are better things to do on a Sunday than catch up on admin. A little less admin means a little more time for yourself.
